svg.title: Mine ventilation technician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as mine ventilation technician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A sparse three-blade ventilation fan connects to a short side duct with a separate lower pressure gauge. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
